description.text:
*Job Overview*

As an Administrative Assistant / Accounts Payable professional, you’ll keep daily office operations organized while supporting accurate bookkeeping. You’ll welcome visitors, manage front desk activity, and help clients and colleagues get timely, professional support. This role suits someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable handling confidential information, and ready to balance administrative tasks with accounts payable work.

*Duties*

* Process invoices and enter data, and support bookkeeping tasks using QuickBooks.
* Answer and route calls on a multi-line phone system; gr
